title: Does Premium Version Adoption in mHealth Improve User Engagement and Health-Related Outcomes?
authors: Yikun Jiang; Kosuke Uetake; Nathan Yang
eligible_reason: Staggered binary adoption (premium upgrade) at user-specific weeks 2-7 (6 cohorts) with a large never-adopter group; main-text TWFE static (Table 3) and unstacked TWFE event studies (Figures 2-3 left; Figure 8 matched sample) with user and week FE, no controls, clustered by user; CSA (did::att_gt) reported alongside. Caveat: the time index is weeks since registration (weeks_join), not calendar time; all users share the same 1-15 index so the staggered DiD structure is intact, but calendar shocks are not absorbed (registration dates differ). Lead to confirm this satisfies the calendar-time-FE rule.
design_notes: User-week panel (balanced, 15 weeks since registration). Treatment: premium upgrade in week_upgrade in {2,...,7}; never-adopters have week_upgrade > 100; week-1 adopters excluded from the analysis sample. treated_time = 1[week_upgrade <= weeks_join] is absorbing (upgraded never switches off in data). Static TWFE: feols(y ~ treated_time | userid + weeks_join, cluster=~userid) (Table_3.R). Event study: relative-time dummies -3..-1, 0..12, 13+ with userid + weeks_join FE (Figure_2_3_Left.R; coefficients in Appendix Tables D1-D2). CSA: att_gt(tname=weeks_join, idname=userid, gname=week_upgrade, xformla = baseline covariates incl. first_day/demographics/first-week engagement/Google search indices, control_group='notyettreated', est_method='dr'), aggte simple (Table 3) and dynamic (Figures 2-3 right, Table 5, Figure 7 HonestDiD). Matched-sample TWFE event studies via MatchIt nearest neighbour (Figure 8: week 5-6 adopters vs never; Figures 9-10: week-5 adopters only, split by exposure). Appendix: dCDH did_multiplegt_dyn (Table C1), sdid (Table C2), alternative measurement (Table B1).
estimators_reported: TWFE event study (Figures 2-3 left; Figure 8-10 matched samples; Appendix D1-D2)
Callaway-Sant'Anna (did::att_gt, DR with covariates, not-yet-treated controls; Table 3, Figures 2-3 right, Table 5, Figure 7 with HonestDiD)

data_files: replication_files/replication_files/data/simulated_data.csv (178,095 user-weeks; 11,873 users; 42 columns; SIMULATED: resampled users with added noise)
software_detail: R (fixest::feols, did::att_gt, MatchIt, HonestDiD, DIDmultiplegtDYN); one Stata script (Appendix_Table_C2.do, sdid)
replication_feasible_note: Code is complete and runs on the shipped simulated data, but README states the original data are under NDA and the simulated data will not reproduce the published numbers. Real data needed from Yikun Jiang.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). Simulated-data cohort sizes: 118/68/67/40/44/19 adopters in weeks 2-7, 426 week-1 adopters (dropped), 11,091 never-adopters. Time FE are weeks-since-registration, not calendar weeks (flag for lead). Published coefficients unknown; fill from the published PDF. CSA in the paper is covariate-adjusted DR with not-yet-treated controls, so protocol-standard CSA (no covariates) will differ from the reported CSA.
